connection.provenance: Transport/UUIDs from the APK ble-config dictionary group; bare AA/BA framing (Q0 false) for this exact model; no handshake is sent because the APK shows none for earbuds; mirrors the BP1 Pro path, not hardware verified; docs/apk-feature-parity-audit.md (cross-check 2026-10-07); APK 2.17.0.1 DeviceManager exact-name guards, app_device_ble_config dictionary and assets/gesture lists

sound.provenance: Existing reviewed bass command contract; docs/apk-feature-parity-audit.md

anc.provenance: APK 2.17.0.1 (REA re-audit): HeadPhoneMainActivity/NoiseReduceManger path. BA34 <mode> <parameter>; AA34 01 is only success (00/other rejected) and state is re-read with BA33 -> AA33 mode,type,type1,type2 (NoiseReduceManger.s/u). NoiseReduceDataModel.f lists 104 self-adaptive, 102 indoor, 103 outdoor, 101 commute and Custom (DeviceManager.l range 1-5); no voice transparency selector; not hardware verified

eq.provenance: APK 2.17.0.1 shows an EQ card for this model, but preset filters come from the server eq_sound_mode parameter, which is not captured for it. Presets copied from BP1 Pro were removed; no runtime EQ until its own parameters are reviewed
